howItWorks.subtitle: How We Work
howItWorks.title: A Simple Way to Sell Scrap
howItWorks.intro: Tell us what you have and where it is located. We'll review the details, arrange collection where applicable, and confirm the final value after evaluation and weighing.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Reach out by phone, WhatsApp or the contact form.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Tell us what materials you have, approximate quantity and your location.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our team reviews the details and provides an initial assessment.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Collection is arranged where applicable and materials are accurately weighed.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Payment is completed according to the agreed terms after final evaluation.

services.subtitle: Why choose al nuraq
services.title: Scrap Buying Made Simple
services.service1Desc: We evaluate your scrap based on its type, quality, quantity and current market conditions, with clear communication throughout the process.
services.service2Desc: We arrange convenient collection services for homes, businesses, factories and other locations across our service areas.
services.service3Desc: From household scrap to large industrial loads, we provide practical buying and collection solutions for individuals and businesses.
services.service4Desc: Your material is weighed and assessed before the final value is confirmed, keeping the transaction straightforward and transparent.

testimonials.subtitle: Our Testimonial
testimonials.title: Built Around Reliable Service
testimonials.testimonial1Quote: Al Nuraq provided excellent service for our scrap collection. The team was professional, punctual, and offered a fair price. Highly recommended for anyone looking to sell scrap.
testimonials.testimonial2Quote: Al Nuraq collected industrial scrap from our factory quickly and paid a fair price. Professional team and transparent weighing.
testimonials.testimonial3Quote: Great pickup service — the team coordinated timing and handled loading professionally. Payment was prompt and as quoted.
testimonials.testimonial4Quote: Very reliable for household scrap. Team arrived on time and gave clear guidance on separation and pricing. Highly recommended.

newsBlog.subtitle: What we Buy
newsBlog.title: What Scrap Does Al Nuraq Buy?
newsBlog.description: We buy a wide range of metal, industrial and recyclable materials, from copper and aluminium to machinery, cables and electronic scrap. Our services are available for individuals, businesses, factories, construction sites and warehouses.
newsBlog.title1: All types of ferrous and non-ferrous metal scrap for buying and collection.
newsBlog.title2: Copper cables, pipes, industrial copper and recoverable copper materials.
newsBlog.title3: Aluminium profiles, sheets, cans, industrial and structural aluminium.
newsBlog.title4: Structural steel, iron beams, rebar, plates and heavy metal scrap.
newsBlog.title5: Copper and aluminium cables, electrical wires and wiring harnesses.
newsBlog.title6: Industrial machines, motors, compressors and heavy equipment.
newsBlog.title7: Electronic components, circuit boards, computer scrap and electronics waste.
newsBlog.title8: Lead-acid batteries, industrial batteries and automotive batteries.
newsBlog.title9: Factory equipment, industrial components and bulk industrial materials.
newsBlog.title10: Control panels, switchboards, electrical boards and distribution panels.
newsBlog.title11: Air compressors, AC compressors, industrial compressors and pumps.
newsBlog.title12: Demolition metal, construction waste and structural material scrap.
newsBlog.title13: End-of-life vehicles, car parts, automotive metal and components.
newsBlog.title14: Old appliances, household metal items and domestic scrap materials.
